m.i.title: megamesh.sh — Your server, your exit.
m.i.description: Megamesh dey turn the cheapest VPS into a hardened personal WireGuard VPN with web admin. Three open ports, key-only SSH, fail2ban, automatic TLS, weekly health-checked upgrades with rollback. Script, AI prompt, or one-click deployer. Open source, MIT.
m.i.og_description: Hardened personal WireGuard VPN for a 1 GB VPS. Script for sysops, prompt for AI agents, web deployer for everybody else. Open source, MIT.
i.008: Your own VPN · one IP and root away
i.010: Megamesh dey turn the cheapest VPS wey you fit rent into a hardened personal WireGuard VPN with web admin for your devices. Three open ports, key-only SSH, automatic TLS, weekly upgrades wey dey roll back by themselves. Your own, auditable, MIT.
i.020: If you rent tunnel, you be subscriber. If you dey run one, you be the operator. Commercial VPNs na for crowd, no be for you: shared exit, privacy policy wey you just dey trust blindly, box wey you no go ever see. Most self-hosting guides dey stop for “WireGuard is up” come leave door open. Megamesh na the rest of the job — hardened by default, on top VPS wey cost less than the subscription.
i.023: One bash file wey you fit read for ten minutes, prompt for your AI agent, and the configs wey dey run on top the reference server — published full, MIT, wey three frontier models audit twice with every finding and wetin dem do about am.
i.025: Idempotent, non-interactive, every setting na environment variable. If you run am again, e go keep your choices.
i.027: PROMPT.md carry the goal, the safety rules and the six traps wey we hit, so the agent go start from the end.
i.029: IP, root password, domain, email. E go change the root password to the one you choose, install, and hand over your admin login.
i.036:
Three doors.
Every oda place na wall.
i.037: The public internet dey reach exactly three ports. The firewall default na DROP, no be reject: scanners dey get total silence. Inside, two containers and small host settings — dem write all down, none of dem dey do fake oversmart.
i.040: tcp/22, udp/51820, tcp/443 and nothing else. No port 80, no admin port, no Docker ports wey dey leak out. ICMP limited to ping and path-MTU.
i.042: Password login go stay on until key prove say e dey work, then e go comot. Three tries, 24 h bans wey go double to 30 days. 76,073 attempts become small addresses.
i.044: Caddy dey terminate 443 with Let's Encrypt over TLS-ALPN — port 80 no dey open at all. HSTS, strict headers, Server header stripped.
i.047: Peers, QR codes, stats, 2FA. The UI port no dey public at all; dem dey create the admin account unattended before 443 go fit reach, so nobody fit rush you enter wizard.
i.050: topgrade dey pull packages and container images, restart, verify say the tunnel dey up and admin dey answer — or e go roll back to the images wey work. Pinned by SHA-256.
i.052: Admin hand reach only from inside
i.053: One command go make the admin page answer only through the tunnel; outsiders go get 302 to any URL you choose. Certificates go dey renew.
i.056: No wizard, no questions. The installer dey run the same five stages every time and e no go open door wey e no fit prove say you fit walk pass.
i.058: Swap, hostname, kernel modules wey the container go need.
i.060: Full system update, Docker from de signed repo, daily automatic updates on.
i.062: Firewall first, then sshd, fail2ban, sysctl. No lock anything before firewall open.
i.064: wg-easy alone, admin account proven, before Caddy. Fail closed if error dey.
i.066: Handshake, ports, certificate retry, timers. Then e go give you credentials.
i.067: failed SSH logins wey the reference server collect for 25 days before Megamesh — with fail2ban “running” but zero jails. After: small handful of banned addresses, and silence.
i.068: Typical VPS image, untouched<small>ports dey answer from internet</small>
i.069: WireGuard box where dem follow guide<small>wg + ssh + web + docker leaks</small>
i.073: Personal VPN dey change who dey see your traffic, no be whether person dey see am. The repository talk clearly wetin dem try and wetin dem never try.
i.075: Your VPS provider dey see your traffic as e dey leave their network. Megamesh dey hide you from café Wi-Fi and your ISP, no be from subpoena.
i.077: One admin, your devices. wg-easy dey support many peers, but the hardening assume say na one operator wey dem trust dey handle am.
i.079: E go change your root password but e go leave SSH with password until person install key, and e leave 2FA plus VPN-only mode for you to turn on. Twenty minutes with the hardening notes go finish am.
i.080: No be everywhere dem test am
i.081: CentOS Stream 9 and Ubuntu 24.04 for 1 vCPU / 1 GB VPS don verify end-to-end — the second one through the deployer self. Rocky, Alma and Debian dey share those code paths but dem never run them yet.
i.084: Once your devices enter the tunnel, everything wey you dey do dey leave from your server address. Na that be the point — and something wey others fit use: friend fit allow-list you, your own boxes fit trust you, rate limit fit give you exception. The author publish him own, and the repository na the source of truth for am.
i.111: To publish am na defence self. Lie-lie news, fake news, or “person break enter our app” accusation — every move for internet dey leave address for log. Declare your own for public, with start date, so dat any trace wey come from another place no be you, based on your own declaration. E no prove say you clean by itself, but e dey give you power: public, dated, verifiable statement wey you make before anybody get reason to doubt am.
i.089: Verifydig +short A paulfleury.network · dig +short -x 151.243.225.214 — dem must agree
i.090: E dey identify server, no be person. Keep authentication for front of wetin you allow-list — and another person rely dey use the address before the start date; nothing from before dat time belong to the author.
i.092: One operator, dem publish am full.
i.093: Megamesh na the single-person version of the boxes wey megastack.sh, the author's cybersecurity consultancy, dey build for clients — e design and operate with an AI agent over SSH, then three other models tear am apart before e go public.
i.094: Paul Fleury — French internet entrepreneur for Lisbon, wey don dey hack around for internet since late nineties.
i.095: The whole story — the logbook for first deployment, the audits, the fixes — dey inside the repository.

m.d.title: Deploy Megamesh on your VPS · megamesh.sh
m.d.description: Give the deployer your VPS IP, root password, domain and email. E go change root password to the one you choose, install Megamesh and hand over with your admin credentials.
d.008: Four things, then wait. The deployer go log into your server over SSH, change root password to the one you choose, install Megamesh exactly as the public script go do, come back with your admin login. Nothing wey you type dey saved anywhere — e dey live inside dis tab and for the requests wey dey carry am.
d.014: New VPS with CentOS Stream 9 or Ubuntu 24.04 (we don verify both end to end, even through this page) — Rocky/Alma 9 and Debian 12 fit work but we no don test dem yet. 1 vCPU and 1 GB of RAM dey enough. You need root over SSH with a password, plus a domain name wey you fit edit DNS for.
d.017: Current root password <small>from your provider email or panel</small>
d.018: New root password <small style="font-weight:400;color:var(--faint)">· we recommend say you change am</small>
d.019: The one Wey your provider send don pass email already. The deployer go replace am for the server before it install anything, and go dey use the new one from dat time. Save am for your password manager now; e go show again for hand-over.
d.020: New root password <small>12–128 characters, no spaces — or leave am empty to keep the current one</small>
d.024: Your SSH public key <small>optional — if you have one, it goes in and the server go fully harden</small>
d.025: Read before you click. Your root password dey go over HTTPS to megamesh.sh, wey we dey use log into your server for the duration of the install, and we go discard am. Each status refresh dey log in again with am. We no dey keep copy or logs of am. If you no want, the script dey give the same result without us for middle.
d.028: Don log in. See wetin the deployer find, and wetin e wan do now.
d.029: I agree say the install dey take 10–30 minutes, say my root password dey pass through megamesh.sh dat time and we no dey store am, and say SSH go stay password-protected until key enter.
d.033: Package updates for 1 vCPU box dey take small time — 10 to 30 minutes na normal thing. You fit leave this tab open; the install go continue for your server even if you close am, and if you re-open deployer with the same details e go pick am back up.
d.042: Three things remain, all for your side. Save the credentials first — dem go show only once.
d.043: Point your domain to the server. For your DNS provider (Namecheap, Cloudflare, OVH…), create A record: host @, value . Remove any parking or redirect record for the same name. Caddy for your server dey wait already and go fetch certificate by itself once the record resolve — normally within minutes.
d.044: Log in. Open (type the https://), sign in with the admin credentials above, then enable two-factor authentication under your account. Add device, scan the QR code, connect.
d.045: Get a techie friend to finish the hardening — twenty minutes with the hardening notes: install an SSH key and turn passwords off, optionally make the admin page VPN-only. Everything else (firewall, fail2ban, automatic updates, weekly health-checked upgrades) dey run already.
d.046: Credentials on the server. One copy of the admin login dey inside /root/megamesh-admin-credentials for your VPS, na only root fit read am. Once you save everything for password manager, delete am:
d.047: I don save dem — delete the copy for the server
